FIVE THINGS AT ONCE. He is named with HIS WIFE — «marito di MURABITO VENERA» — which is the couple together in a document for the first time since their son's marriage act of 1872. He was BORN AT GIARRE, which is where Giovanni said he was born and is the likeliest reason Giovanni said it. He is about NINETY, so born about 1800. He is a CONTADINO at contrada Montargi. And he has PARENTS: SIMONE NICOTRA and MARIANNA MUSUMECI, both dead by 1890 — a seventh generation this archive did not have.
«MARITO», NOT «VEDOVO». The register writes «vedovo» for a widower on the same pages. So VENERA MURABITO WAS STILL ALIVE ON 4 APRIL 1890, and her death is the next thing to find.

Not in this series and not in any other: the Catania deposit runs 1843 then 1845 across Nati, Morti, Matrimoni, Nati esposti, Matrimoni processetti and the memorandum, and the ark and segnatura counters step by exactly one across the gap (an_ua70313/16777 to an_ua70314/16778), so the year was never deposited rather than lost from the listing. Verified against a whole listing on 21 September: 498 results, 498 distinct arks, facets agreeing. Giarre has 1844; Mascali does not. THERE IS NOTHING HERE TO READ, which is the opposite of an outstanding year, and the births negative for 1839-1848 is complete without it.

TWO N ENTRIES AND NO CHILD OF GIOVANNI'S. Neri Francesco 26 (paternità Domenico) and NICOTRA MARIA 47, 28 March, paternità GAETANO — a different household, and a NAMESAKE TRAP worth stating plainly: there are now TWO Maria Nicotras born at Mascali in the mid-1870s, this one of Gaetano in 1874 and the archive's own of Giovanni on 8 December 1875. Anyone searching the surname and the decade will meet both. The absence of a child of Giovanni's in 1874 is expected rather than a gap: Venera was born in December 1873 and Maria in December 1875. THREE N ENTRIES, TWO OF THEM NICOTRA, AND THE ONE I READ IS GAETANO'S. Nicotra Mariano 4, NICOTRA ROSARIA 8, Nucifora Mariano 132. No paternità column again, so act 8 was fetched: «è comparso GAETANO NICOTRA, di anni 43, lavorante, domiciliato in Mascali ... del dì sette del corrente mese, nella casa posta in NUNZIATA ... da CARMELA CAVALLARO di lui moglie ... a cui dà il nome di ROSARIA» — born 7 January 1877. That is the same Gaetano who fathered Maria in 1874, and it is a fifteenth household, not Giovanni's. ACT 4, NICOTRA MARIANO, IS STILL UNREAD and is the open question in this year. Act 12, container LNjgzOA, folio 52, and the act itself read in the original at folio 23: «D. FRANCESCO NICOTRA di anni VENTICINQUE, NATO IN GIARRE, di professione CALZOLAJO, domiciliato in Giarre, figlio di D. GIUSEPPE e di ROSARIA MISANO di anni sessantaquattro», marrying MARIA SAPIENZA of Riposto, 24, daughter of the late Giuseppe Sapienza calzolajo and Agata Vitano. Promise 12 June 1830, church 14 June. THE «D.» IS DON, on the groom and on his father both, and the trade is artisan rather than labouring — so this is the TITLED Giarre Nicotra, the family the birth registers show as «Dottor Don Alfio» in 1846 and 1848, and NOT the bracciante line of Rosario. It is recorded as the Giarre Nicotra it is, not as a lead to the one being hunted. The Tavola indexes by the GROOM'S surname, so a Nicotra bride would not appear under N.
